newsitem.title: INDIA: India Mahavir Spinning 96/97 net rises.
newsitem.headline: India Mahavir Spinning 96/97 net rises.

text.p: India's Mahavir Spinning Mills said on Wednesday it earned a net profit of 374.5 million rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) compared with 202.4 million in 1995/96.
The Company said in a statement it had set the 1996/97 dividend at 32 percent compared with 30 percent in the previous year.
The turnover of the company increased to 5.81 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 4.99 billion rupees in 1995/96, the statement said.
"With increased production, the export turnover has increased to 1.66 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 1.28 billion in the previous year," it said.
